title: Added voices to AI Agents in Minecraft so they can talk to each other
author: daybeliever1

comments.author: curseof_death
comments.body: What do you mean AI agents in Minecraft?

replies.author: daybeliever1
replies.body:
This is the Altera Agent mod on Java 1.19, it brings in autonomous AI bots with customizable personalities and backstories into Minecraft. To make it more interactive, we added the capability to have the bots speak what they type in chat.   


It's currently in pre-alpha testing with weekly improvements, but we are bringing in external testers. Let me know if you're interested!
